title: finding(core): `record-title.ts` numbers the same record-key fallback `3b` in one docblock and `4b` in another
body:
`packages/core/src/utils/record-title.ts` gives one precedence rung two different
numbers, 26 lines apart in the same file.

## The two sites

```
packages/core/src/utils/record-title.ts:355   (RecordDisplayNameOptions.deriveFromRecordKeys)
 * record when `objectDef.fields` is absent (precedence step 3b). Defaults to

packages/core/src/utils/record-title.ts:381   (the getRecordDisplayName docblock)
 *   4b. standard name-ish keys probed directly on the record
 *      ({@link NAME_ISH_RECORD_KEYS}) — the safety net for when `fields` is
 *      absent so derivation can't run.
```

Both describe the same thing: the `NAME_ISH_RECORD_KEYS` probe that runs when
`objectDef.fields` is absent, gated by the `deriveFromRecordKeys` option.

## Which one is stale

`4b` is right and `3b` is the leftover. Both ladders in this file number the
type-aware derivation from `objectDef.fields` as step **4** — the module
docblock at line 37 and the resolver docblock at line 380 — and the record-key
probe is the `b` variant sitting immediately under it, before the `Record #id`
floor at step 5. `3` is `objectDef.titleFormat` in both ladders, which is a
rendered template and not a record-key probe. The `3b` spelling reads like a
survival from a pre-ADR-0079-Phase-2 numbering, before the declared `nameField`
was promoted above `titleFormat`.

## Why it is worth recording

Same class as objectui#6572, and the same reason that one was worth a card
rather than a silent edit: these docblocks are the passage a reader consults to
learn which pointer wins where, and other files cite the numbering by hand — the
`InterfaceListPage` prose corrected in objectui#6572 names steps 0/1/2/3/4
explicitly and takes those numbers from here. A rung with two numbers means one
of the two citations a reader carries away is wrong, and there is nothing
mechanical anywhere that would notice.

Observation only. No behaviour change: the numbers appear exclusively in comment
text, and `deriveFromRecordKeys` itself is unaffected either way.

## Scope note

Found from inside objectui#6572, whose fence is two `packages/app-shell` files.
This is `packages/core` — a different package, so fixing it in that PR would
have widened the changeset's affected-package set and the verification face.
Filed unassigned rather than folded in.

## Duplicate scan before filing

The repo-scoped REST channel this container has does not expose
`/search/issues` (`403 — sessions are bound to their configured repositories.
Use repository-scoped endpoints`), so this went through one targeted MCP
`search_issues` instead: *"record-title.ts getRecordDisplayName precedence
ladder step numbering wrong in doc comment prose"*, 8 hits. objectui#6572
returned in that set as the positive control, so the scan is a live reading and
not an empty one. Nearest neighbours are different artifacts: objectui#6531 (the
removal itself), objectui#6558 (a dead resolver copy in `apps/console`),
objectui#6530 (the plugin-map README). None is about this file's internal step
numbering.

Refs: objectui#6572 · objectui#6531
